levels.surface: شريك بن عبد الله بن أبي نمر

notes: «رواه موسى وعلي بن عبد الحميد عن سليمان» names other transmitters for the same saying: a variant group, never a route
«هو المقبري» after سعيد is an identifying gloss, left out; surface is سعيد
Anas is the last link of the route; the Prophet at the end of the variant is not a link
the questioner Dimam is inside the story, not a link
